vi(n), [cf S. -vin; BHS -āvin, -vin]; possessive suffix to nouns; added to pp to form adjective with sense of part.perf.act. (see BHSG § 22:51; W. Geiger, 1994, § 198,3); — ifc see aghāvi(n), aññātāvi(n), anikīḷitāvi(n), abhisametāvi(n), katāvi(n), kīḷitāvi(n).
